description: Fetch the full document for one search result id (from the search tool). Accepts token:<chain>:<address>, program:<chain>:<address>, or pool:<address>. Returns the entity detail (on-chain state for pools, census entry for tokens, registry/introspection for programs) as a document.

id.description: A search result id, e.g. "pool:G5d3qFZq..." or "token:robinhood:0x5fc5..." or "program:solana:3AMM53..."

name: fetch
